rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and appropriately cautious about single-image limits, but it infers ICM/TE detail and possible grade inconsistency without clearly visible support and gives little on zona features.
Integrates maternal age, prior biochemical pregnancy, endometrial thickness, sperm parameters, BMI, partner age, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality; AMH is unavailable and not overinterpreted.
Reasoning is mostly logical and the prognosis follows from morphology plus age-related aneuploidy risk, though there are minor inconsistencies in euploidy estimates and some speculative comments.

Recommendations are broadly aligned with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, caution about overreacting to one failed untested transfer, and selective consideration of PGT-A/cavity workup. Minor deviations include somewhat casual mention of extra testing and fresh-vs-freeze speculation.
Provides practical next steps for transfer management, luteal support, lifestyle optimization, and future evaluation after failure, though some advice remains general rather than protocol-specific.
